sources.title: Shenandoah Computing LLC: air construction permit application, public version (Olsson project 025-01320, April 2026), posted by MoDNR as the public construction permit application complete, September 2026
sources.publisher: Missouri Department of Natural Resources, Air Pollution Control Program
sources.attribution: Missouri Department of Natural Resources (application prepared for Shenandoah Computing LLC)
sources.summary: Public version of the air construction permit application of Shenandoah Computing LLC (MoDNR project 2025-08-034, installation 165-0050). The applicant seeks to construct a facility near Platte City, Missouri, to be named Shenandoah Computing LLC, at the south-west corner of Highway 92 and North Winan Avenue (the narrative spells it 'Wian'), classified SIC 7374 (computer processing and data preparation) and NAICS 518210 (data processing, hosting and related services). The emission units are 240 emergency diesel engines ('Type 1') and 10 further engines ('Type 2') serving five buildings B1-B5 (36 + 14 engines each), 60 cooling towers (12 per building), 260 diesel belly tanks, and emergency engines for an administration hub, wastewater plant, lift station, fire pumps, site entrance, booster pump and warehouse; a site-wide NOx limit of 249 tons per year is requested to stay a minor source. The MoDNR form (signed 6 April 2026) names Shenandoah Computing LLC as owner and projects construction from October 2026 and start-up in February 2028. Appendix A has a location map, a topographic map and a site map (Figure 3) with the fenceline and building outlines, each a GeoPDF page with an embedded NAD 1983 StatePlane Missouri West georeference.
sources.date_semantics: published_at is 2 September 2026, the 'Last revised' date of MoDNR's document page for this file (captured as modnr-shenandoah-platte-city-doc-2026-09.html; the PDF's own modification date is 2 September 2026 and it sits in the department's 2026/09 file store). MoDNR's pending-permits register gives 1 September 2026 as the date the application was administratively complete, in the live register of 26 October 2026 and in the Internet Archive copy of 17 October 2026. The status observation is the department's publication of the complete public application on 2 September 2026; the applicant's April 2026 preparation date and its October 2026 / February 2028 dates are not observations.
sources.pages_reviewed: pages 1-13 (cover letter, narrative, emission-unit table, requested limitations, Appendix A maps) and the MoDNR form in Appendix C; the emission workbooks were scanned for dates only
sources.personal_data_note: The cover letter and form name consultant and company representatives with phone numbers and e-mail addresses; none are copied. Only the company names Shenandoah Computing LLC and Olsson are used.
